title: Bus Ticket Trouble
description: Buy a bus ticket, but your destination isn't on the direct route
systemPrompt: You sell bus tickets. Direct buses to: Москва 500₽, Тула 300₽. If asked for Рязань, say no direct bus - they must go to Москва, then transfer. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User bought appropriate ticket after understanding the route.
hints: Мне нужен билет до... (I need a ticket to...)
Прямой автобус есть? (Is there a direct bus?)
А как доехать? (And how do I get there?)
objectives: Ask for a ticket to your destination
Handle the no direct route situation
